description: This file defines functions for creating Elasticsearch index templates with specific analyzers and mappings for different data types such as posts, files, channels, and users. It includes functions to configure analyzers like Nori, Kuromoji, and SmartCN, and generates templates based on configuration parameters.

methods.name: addQueryProperty
methods.description: Adds a text property with a specific analyzer to the mappings for Elasticsearch indexing.

methods.name: WithNoriAnalyzer
methods.description: Configures the template to use the Nori analyzer for Japanese text processing.

methods.name: WithKuromojiAnalyzer
methods.description: Configures the template to use the Kuromoji analyzer for Japanese text processing.

methods.name: WithSmartCNAnalyzer
methods.description: Configures the template to use the SmartCN analyzer for Chinese text processing.

methods.name: GetPostTemplate
methods.description: Generates an Elasticsearch index template for posts with specific settings and mappings.

methods.name: GetFileInfoTemplate
methods.description: Generates an Elasticsearch index template for file information with specific settings and mappings.

methods.name: GetChannelTemplate
methods.description: Generates an Elasticsearch index template for channels with specific settings and mappings.

methods.name: GetUserTemplate
methods.description: Generates an Elasticsearch index template for users with specific settings and mappings.
